No, not on my own authority. My notes say the owner is against useless tests and against repeated identical CI runs. He never asked me to cancel tests or reduce the number of delegates.

I don't have his exact words from late 10-15, so I can't quote what he said about CI. The related standing rules are "no unit tests" and the new `checkOnce` behavior, where a check runs at most once per tree. That addresses repeated identical runs without removing coverage.

If you want tests cut or cancelled, that's his call. I'd ask him with AskUserQuestion rather than decide it myself.
